newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northland Cranberries rating cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she downgraded Northland Cranberries Inc to hold from a buy and cut her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $0.25 a share from $0.70.
-- She also reduced her fiscal third quarter earnings estimate to $0.02 a share from $0.11 and her fourth quarter estimate to $0.01 a share from $0.30. Her fiscal 1998 estimate remains $1.10 a share.
-- In a report, Wittenburg said she believes the "long-term story remains intact."

-- Wittenburg said she downgraded Northland after an announcement late Thursday that its pending acquisition of a private-label juice bottler and distributor was abruptly and unexpectedly terminated by the seller for undisclosed reasons.

-- "We now know that Northland had been withholding (cranberry juice) concentrate sales in large part because the company had expected to sign a deal with an undisclosed party this week, and would have wanted the product for its own uses," Wittenburg said.
-- She added that, based on her estimates, Northland's proposed acquisition could have added between $100 million to $200 million in sales to its 1996 sales base of $38 million.

-- "Because the delayed sales will now cause an earnings shortfall for Northland anyway, we expect the company to further curtail its fiscal 1997 earnings potential to build its branded (juice) product," Wittenburg said.
